item.title: Chillicothe Trash Route Change For Martin Luther King, Jr. Day Holiday
item.description: The City of Chillicothe and CMU offices will be closed on Monday, January 19th in observance of Martin Luther King, Jr Day. CMU Trash routes on Monday will be picked up on Tuesday, January 20th, along with the normal Tuesday trash routes.

item.title: Contract For Legal Services Approved
item.description: A contract for legal services was approved by the Chillicothe City Council in a closed executive session. The contract with Jackson Lewis P.C. is to represent the City of Chillicothe in contract negotiations with the Firefighters Union, IAFF Local 2460. The city will pay the hourly rate of $535 an hour for municipalities.
